description.en:
Host-only console commands to search the current shop catalogue and spawn any vehicle or trailer at the player's position. A successful spawn charges the owning farm the item's default shop price.
Changelog 1.2.0.0: - Added an optional free-spawn parameter that skips the affordability check and money deduction. - Added compatibility protection against obsolete FS19 ExtendedAnimationSounds scripts that can cause the vehicle shop to load indefinitely. - Improved failed-load cleanup and console feedback.
Changelog 1.1.0.0: - Added vehicle and trailer catalogue filtering. - Added configurable spawn distance.
Changelog 1.0.0.0: - Initial release.
